opening: It has been getting worse; it's worse now than when it began.
It began two years after I started vismodegib, about 8 years ago, as loose stools two or three times a day.
My sense of taste has changed.
I've taken vismodegib 150 mg every day for 10 years.
I have basal cell carcinoma that is locally advanced and has spread (metastatic).

opening.text: I'm here because I've had watery diarrhea that's been getting worse than when it started. It began about eight years ago, two years after I started taking vismodegib 150 mg every day, which I've now been on for ten years. I have locally advanced metastatic basal cell carcinoma and Gorlin syndrome. I've also noticed hair loss, a change in my sense of taste, and I get muscle spasms.
